title: The tracked machine's source step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$ whose state is present. For any integer lower and upper bounds $\ell_i,h_i$ on each work tape $i$, one step of the tracked machine from the completed tracked configuration of $c$ with those bounds equals the intermediate stamping configuration associated with the one-step successor of $c$, using the same bounds.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$\ell$ and $h$ assign integer bounds to every work tape
replaced:
Let $c$ be a live configuration of the source machine with visited bounds $\ell$ and
$h$. One step of the tracked evaluator from the completed tracked configuration of $c$
equals the intermediate stamp configuration of the one-step successor of $c$ with the
same bounds: the data bank performs the source write and emission, and all three per-
tape heads move by the same source action.
